prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original art-bible calibration keyframe for a cross-platform fantasy RTS/RPG, viewed from the playable strategy camera
Primary request: create a completely original game-environment keyframe showing a weary field engineer and two companions arriving at a small inhabited refuge built into an ancient terraced stone quarry at blue-hour dusk; workers repair rope bridges and timber retaining walls while a subtle geological anomaly bends one distant shadow and reveals a thin amber mineral seam; the place feels lived-in, vulnerable, useful, and worth protecting
Scene/backdrop: broad readable valley bowl, weathered stone terraces, sparse wind-bent pines, practical gardens, water channel, repair yard, one distant landmark tower made from mismatched local masonry; two visible exploration paths and a defensible central basin
Subject: human-scale refuge and landscape are primary; three small traveler silhouettes provide scale, not character-design detail
Style/medium: polished stylized-realistic 3D game concept art with painterly color grading, believable PBR-like stone, timber, cloth and earth, deliberately simplified large forms, production-feasible geometry
Composition/framing: wide elevated three-quarter isometric strategy-game camera, landscape navigation and silhouettes immediately readable at 1080p, calm foreground approach leading toward warm inhabited center, distant landmark visible
Lighting/mood: wistful, earthy, wondrous, determined; cool desaturated blue-gray wilderness contrasted with restrained warm window and forge islands; one dominant low sun/sky direction, baked-light feeling, light localized haze only
Color palette: roughly 60 percent muted earth and stone, 30 percent cool pine and dusk blue, 10 percent amber anomaly and inhabited warmth
Materials/textures: worn local stone, repaired timber, patched canvas, packed soil, moss used sparingly; visible signs of labor and maintenance
Constraints: entirely original world and design; strong RTS readability; no text, no logo, no interface, no watermark; no ornate heroic palace, no giant character close-up, no neon magic fog, no ray-traced spectacle, no photobash artifacts; no recognizable borrowed imagery, iconic pre-existing characters, copied architecture, copied maps, or familiar emblems
